title: GEMglGetPointerv
description: return the address of the specified pointer

messages.description: pointer to query (broken in Gem: goes to a missing 'v' method)

arguments.description: pointer to query (broken in Gem: goes to a missing 'v' method)

methods.description: array or buffer pointer to query, e.g. GL_VERTEX_ARRAY_POINTER

body: [GEMglGetPointerv] calls glGetPointerv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Gem doesn't do anything with the pointer it gets; it only posts it. See glGetPointerv in the OpenGL reference.
